#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(NULL);
    
    int n;
    long long b;
    cin >> n >> b;
    vector<int> a(n);
    vector<int> c(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        cin >> a[i];
        c[i] = (a[i] % 2 == 0) ? 1 : -1;
    }
    
    long long sum = 0;
    map<int, int> freq;
    for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; i++) {
        sum += c[i];
        if (sum == 0) {
            int diff = abs(a[i] - a[i + 1]);
            freq[diff]++;
        }
    }
    
    long long total = 0;
    int count = 0;
    for (auto& entry : freq) {
        int d = entry.first;
        int cnt = entry.second;
        for (int j = 0; j < cnt; j++) {
            if (total + d <= b) {
                total += d;
                count++;
            } else break;
        }
        if (total + d > b) break;
    }
    
    cout << count << "\n";
    return 0;
}
</translated_code>
